assessment: This important study presents a technically impressive and carefully controlled biophysical study of the nature of the mechanosensitivity of voltage-gated sodium channels. The identification of a mechanosensitive step with little voltage sensitivity is convincing, and the proposal of a swinging door mechanism for the intracellular gate is plausible. It is expected to be of interest to scientists studying sodium channels and the physical basis of mechanosensitivity in electrophysiology.
